state: predicted-static; import only after live capture confirms the key (validate_predicted.py confirm + gate on the AQ-01/AQ-03 Stage 2 capture)
method:
W7-STAGE2 F1 detail pass (w2-effects v2 method adapted to the Stage 2 luminance fields; lane-s2, claude-einhander).

Keys: AD934A7E-FC338604 (flames), 3DD37B6B-AFAD5A36 (dark additive smoke), 4915FBCF-056E3BD0 (glow).  All three CLUTs are
STP (additive) wherever visible.  Base = the frozen stage2-opening-fx-v1 export of the same key (prep-v1 / fx-v1 index
master render, cell-isolated, luminance-field RGB, class map exact at every native texel centre).

  guides  per drawn cell: native luminance field Lb (normalised convolution of the CLUT luminance of the visible native
          texels, gaussian 0.55 texel, texel-centred bilinear 8x upsample) -> guide colour = hue-smoothed CLUT colour of Lb
          (flame, glow) or neutral grey (smoke) times a gain that lifts the CLUT's brightest entry to ~230; alpha-0 = black.
          Cells are placed 1:1 on the 8x master grid (glow at 16x, boxed down by 2 after generation) on SDXL-bucket canvases.
  gen     JuggernautXL v9 img2img (core nodes; denoise 0.6, cfg 6, 32 steps, dpmpp_2m karras; w2-effects v2 parameters),
          inside gpu_slot('lane-s2', <= 10 min) after the nvidia-smi health check.
  build   AI luminance / gain = La (inverse ramp: the guide is luminance-exact, so the inverse is a division).
          Low frequencies locked to native: Ln = La + G(Lb - La, 1.6 texel); band limit G(0.7 px) (motion);
          weight = native visibility of the cell (dilated 1 texel, feathered 0.6 texel); outside it Lb.
          Flames only (core_pin): where Lb is within 4-14 lum of the CLUT's brightest entry, Ln is pulled up to max(Ln, Lb)
          (weight ramps 0 -> 1), so the native white-hot plateau stays white and the AI licks live around it.
          Colour = CLUT ramp at Ln (Ramp: visible entries sorted by luminance, entry chroma smoothed over entries within
          ~6 lum units (smoke: the colours themselves, rescaled to the entry luminance, because the chroma of near-black
          entries is ill-conditioned and turned the smoke violet in fx-v2), brightest entry exact, linear interpolation; below the darkest entry the colour fades linearly
          to black; r1/r2 guides were rendered with an earlier per-pixel gaussian ramp, which only tints the guide), faded to the v1
          colour within 1.25 texels of the CLUT's alpha cut; per-cell light energy locked to 0.95-1.05 of native (scalar).
  export  alpha = the v1 class plane, bit-identical; class re-validated at every native texel centre; pixels outside
          every drawn cell = v1 exactly.
usage: python -I f1_detail.py guides|gen|build <run> [job names]
supersedes: stage2-opening-fx-v2 key 3DD37B6B-AFAD5A36 (FAILED there: the per-entry chroma smoothing over near-black CLUT entries turned the smoke saturated violet-blue). AD934A7E-FC338604 and 4915FBCF-056E3BD0 stay in stage2-opening-fx-v2.
